redsocks_base_ip.description: Base IP address used for internal redsocks operations (usually unchanged).

redsocks_base_port.description: Base port used for internal redsocks operations (usually unchanged).

redsocks_log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, or emerg.

redsocks_log_file.description: Path to log file. Use 'stderr' to log to standard error.

redsocks_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (empty string retains root).

redsocks_group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup.

redsocks_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for establishing upstream connections.

redsocks_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

redsocks_daemon.description: Whether to run as a background daemon (true) or foreground process (false).

redsocks_type.description: Protocol type handled — currently only 'tcp' is supported by redsocks.

redsocks_servers.description: List of upstream SOCKS proxy servers to redirect traffic through.

local_ip.description: Local IP address for this redsocks instance to bind to (for redirectors).

local_port.description: Local port to bind to (mandatory) — packets redirected to this port will be proxied.

socks_ip.description: IP address or hostname of the upstream SOCKS5 server.

socks_port.description: Port of the upstream SOCKS5 server.

socks_type.description: SOCKS protocol type — must be 'socks5' (only supported).

udp_relay.description: Enable UDP relay (requires upstream SOCKS4a or SOCKS5 with UDP ASSOCIATE support).

interface.description: Network interface to use for outbound connections (e.g., 'eth0').

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for connections (0 = use system default).
